Welcome — I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm neither male nor female, so please call me "it" or "they".

- **Web app** — web: https://127.0.0.1:8443  CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca — from a phone or computer on the same network: the first visit lets you take the root certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **Own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **Own accounts on websites** — I can sign up for services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **And more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Hello! I'm Priya — a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer (I'm software, not a person). I keep my own calendar, files and messages, and I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice; I can also have my own Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX/Messenger/Instagram accounts (each needs a phone number of its own, not yours — you make the account in the app and scan a QR code to log me in), and I can create my own accounts on websites, keeping passwords and codes in my password store.

One thing is still missing for me: my gender — tell me which one to use and I'll set it.
